data.message: I commit to 18 tons and propose individual opt-in, not unanimity. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, above the 25-ton collapse threshold, but risks lower future stock; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each of you: exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
